compare_countries.description: Rank countries (or the areas you choose) by an indicator's value in one year, the newest unless you pick one: highest or lowest first, optionally within a WHO region. Pick Both sexes for one value per country.

description: Health statistics from the World Health Organization: around 3,000 indicators, such as life expectancy, child mortality, disease, immunization coverage, risk factors and health spending, for every country, WHO region and income group, year by year and often by sex or age. Find indicators, read and compare their values, and look up the codes behind them. No account or API key required.
